title: Can't reach some internal services over corp.local
description: I can't access some services under corp.local such as the wiki and fileshare. DNS resolution is failing.

worklogs.description: Flushed the DNS cache (ipconfig /flushdns), tested different records with nslookup.
Reviewed the DNS server logs with the network team — the user's requests are reaching the server.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, could you share a full list of which services you can't reach (e.g. wiki.corp.local, files.corp.local)? Also, could you run 'nslookup wiki.corp.local' in cmd and send a screenshot of the result?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: wiki.corp.local and files.corp.local won't open. But portal.corp.local opens, strangely.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Thanks. Could you also share the 'ipconfig /all' output? I'd like to see which IPs you're using as DNS servers. By the way, is the VPN connected right now?

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Waiting on the ipconfig output and VPN status from the customer. My guess is the split-DNS configuration is wrong — wiki/files are on a different subnet.
